subject: Uplift orchestration and license smoothing for mid-contract expansion
messages:

Subject: Quick: mid-contract expansion and co-term options

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well. We’re planning to add a new product line to our stack and expect ~35% uplift in inference volume starting July 1. We’d like to understand options to:

- Add capacity mid-contract without creating a new full-year commit,
- Align the new capacity to our existing renewal (co-term), and
- Keep effective unit pricing close to our current blended rate if possible.

Can Redwood provide a few structured options (e.g., prorated top-up, staged voucher, or temporary burst buffer) and an indication of any required lead time? We’ll likely need procurement and finance to sign off, so clarity on invoice timing and a one-page summary would be helpful.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Claire O'Neill
Head of ML Ops, Lumena Inc.
claire@lumenaicorp.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick: mid-contract expansion and co-term options

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and the heads-up on timing. High level — we can support three pragmatic paths depending on how you want billing and risk allocated:

1) Prorated top-up (fastest): One-off invoice for the remaining term proportional to added units. No change to renewal date. Minimal paperwork; invoice moves in the next billing cycle.

2) Voucher / staged uplift (smoothing): You commit to a larger total for the remaining term, but we issue vouchers/credits that are consumed as you use them. This smooths unit pricing and can be structured so the renewal sees a blended effective rate. Requires a short amendment (~2 weeks) and accounting alignment.

3) Temporary burst & conversion: Add burst capacity for initial months at a premium; if usage stabilizes at the higher level we convert to a permanent top-up and annualize at renewal (can trigger a partial credit). Best when you need immediate headroom.

I’ve looped Ben (pricing) and Monica (billing ops) to put together concrete numbers and a one-page comparison. Ben/Monica — can you run a quick model to show: incremental unit price for +35% on current IO mix, estimated prorate invoice in USD for remainder of current term, and an example voucher schedule that would keep blended unit price within ~5% of the current rate? Also include the legal doc path (amendment vs addendum) and typical lead times.

Claire — we’ll aim to get a short one-pager and an example invoice by tomorrow EOD PT. If you prefer a call, I’m available 1:30–3:30pm PT.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Hi Claire — thanks for the patience. Attached are two artifacts: a one-page comparison (redwood_uplift_sched.pdf) and a sample mutual action plan (MAP_Lumena_Q3.xlsx). Summary below:

Option A — Prorated top-up - Immediate invoice (remaining 8 months): $72,400 - Incremental blended unit: +4.8% vs current - Doc: simple amendment; billing posts on next cycle if signed by Tue (June run)

Option B — Voucher / staged uplift (recommended for smoothing) - Voucher pool: $85,000 consumed as used over remaining term - Effective blended unit: +1.7% (after voucher amortization) - Doc: addendum + voucher schedule; ~10 business days to finalize

Option C — Temporary burst then convert - Burst buffer (3 months): $18,000 (premium rate) - If sustained >25% uplift for two months, convert to top-up and credit 30% of burst fees toward top-up - Good when immediate headroom required

Financing/discount notes:
- To hit within 5% of current blended rate, we modeled Option B with a $85k voucher and a ~12% effective discount to incremental list. That is within our standard mid-contract concession band but requires Finance signoff.

Next steps:
1) Claire — pick preferred option and confirm whether procurement needs the amendment language.
2) If Option B chosen, Monica will prepare the addendum and voucher schedule and we’ll route for Finance approval (if needed).
3) We can book a 30-min alignment call Monday 10:00am PT to finalize wording and invoice timing.

Attachments:

- MAP_Lumena_Q3.xlsx (sample mutual action plan)
